options.en: A list of candidates put forward by a party.
options.fr: Une liste de candidats présentée par un parti.

options.en: An area that elects several members of Parliament.
options.fr: Une région qui élit plusieurs députés.

options.en: An area of the country that elects one member of Parliament.
options.fr: Une région du pays qui élit un seul député.

explanation.en: An electoral district is also called a riding or a constituency. Each one elects a single member, who sits in the House of Commons and speaks both for that district and for all Canadians.
explanation.fr: Une circonscription électorale est aussi appelée un comté. Chacune élit un seul député, qui siège à la Chambre des communes et parle au nom de sa circonscription comme au nom de tous les Canadiens.

source.quote: An electoral district is a geographical area represented by a member of Parliament (MP). The citizens in each electoral district elect one MP who sits in the House of Commons to represent them, as well as all Canadians.

verification.evidence: Canada is divided into 308 electoral districts, also known as ridings or constituencies. An electoral district is a geographical area represented by a member of Parliament (MP). The citizens in each electoral district elect one MP who sits in the House of Commons to represent them, as well as all Canadians.
